criterion: which banking customer-service intent the query expresses

categories.name: Card Not Working
categories.definition: User reports that their card is declined, not working, or they are unable to make a payment or withdrawal.

categories.name: Transfer Issue
categories.definition: User reports a problem with a money transfer, including failed, pending, or missing transfers.

categories.name: Top Up Issue
categories.definition: User reports a problem adding money to their account, including failed, pending, or reverted top-ups.

categories.name: Pending Transaction Inquiry
categories.definition: User inquires why a specific transaction is pending or asks when it will complete.

categories.name: Card Management
categories.definition: User requests to order, activate, or replace a physical or virtual card.

categories.name: Card Security
categories.definition: User reports a lost or stolen card, suspects unauthorized use, or requests to freeze the card.

categories.name: ATM Issue
categories.definition: User reports an ATM retained their card or dispensed the wrong amount of cash.

categories.name: Transaction Dispute
categories.definition: User reports an unrecognized, duplicate, or incorrect charge and requests a refund or investigation.

categories.name: Fee Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about fees for services or disputes a specific fee charged to their account.

categories.name: Exchange Rate Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about exchange rates, supported currencies, or the process for currency exchange.

categories.name: Top Up Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about top-up limits, supported methods, or how to add money.

categories.name: Transfer Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about transfer limits, processing times, or how to make a transfer.

categories.name: Card Usage Inquiry
categories.definition: User asks about card usage limits, accepted merchants, or how to use specific card features.

categories.name: PIN Management
categories.definition: User requests to change, unblock, or reset their card PIN.

categories.name: Identity Verification Issue
categories.definition: User reports an error or asks for steps regarding identity or source of funds verification.

categories.name: Account Management
categories.definition: User requests to open, close, or update details on their bank account.

categories.name: Card Delivery Status
categories.definition: User asks about the status, tracking, or delivery time of a physical card.

categories.name: Cancel Transaction
categories.definition: User requests to stop or cancel a pending transfer or payment.

categories.name: Refund Status
categories.definition: User inquires about the status or location of a missing refund.

categories.name: App or Device Issue
categories.definition: User reports issues with the mobile app, their phone, or access to the service.
